title: Bounded Multi-Site list and manual health reads
opportunity: The main Multi-Site list endpoint and the manual per-site health-check endpoint still passed the request cancellation token directly to the PostgreSQL site list query.
rootCause: A slow or unavailable database could leave the page load or manual health action waiting until the client disconnected, while the history/trend endpoints already had a bounded read policy.
implementation: Applied the existing two-second linked SiteHealthReadBudget to GET /api/sites.
Applied the same bounded budget to the initial site lookup in POST /api/sites/{id}/health.
Returned site_health_read_timeout for budget expiry while preserving client cancellation semantics; the probe and health-history write retain the request token and their own controls.

tdd.red: SiteEndpointReadBudgetTests failed before implementation because both endpoint regions lacked the budget token and timeout contract.

verification.uiAuditBoundary: backend-only change; no CSS/HTML/JavaScript assets changed

boundaries: Live PostgreSQL slow-read execution, authenticated browser/published-EXE smoke, visual responsive verification, full VSTest testhost connectivity, CodeQL/SARIF, external penetration testing, load/SLO, SIEM, Authenticode signing, and production certification remain unverified.
